transcript: Doctor: What brings you in today? Patient: I have had a persistent cough for about 2 weeks, some chest tightness, and mild fever around 99.5. Doctor: Any shortness of breath? Patient: A little when climbing stairs. Doctor: I am going to listen to your lungs. There is some wheezing in the lower lobes. I think this looks like acute bronchitis possibly with early pneumonia. I will prescribe azithromycin 500mg for 5 days and a bronchodilator inhaler. Follow up in 2 weeks if no improvement.
